<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:electric-motor -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/electric-motor).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The shaft-link exchange and the unit of speed were not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/11/limitations/2`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Charge scales with the speed step, not with speed × step. A given speed change costs the same at low and high shaft speed, so equal charge buys equal force-weighted speed change rather than equal mechanical work. Turning it into work needs the shaft-link model, which was not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/11/sections/2/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> With infinite_batteries (settings offset 0x33) set the helper returns 1 and removes nothing. Otherwise it returns 0 without a network, else removes min(a × request, network charge) and returns that amount ÷ request, where a = max(0, (300 − n) ÷ 300) × q from node fields n (offset 0x28) and q (offset 0x3c) whose meaning was not recovered. Function 0x1402eeca0-0x1402eed53; instruction bytes 80783300 at 0x1402eecb6. Interpretation rests on retained output investigation/native/behavior/pseudocode/0x1402eeca0.c. Provenance: Ghidra 12.1.4 headless, program imported with -noanalysis and only the cited routine disassembled/decompiled by a local script; this is not an REA session record. Static analysis of this executable only; no game process was run.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/11/findings/12/detail`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Generator electric_magnitude ÷ motor electric_magnitude, valid only if both shaft links weight speed by force_emitter_max_force (not decoded); 0.85 ÷ 1.05 = 0.8095. Inputs: resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_small.xml:5528f1689692:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_medium.xml:6100f8b6ac93:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/generator_large.xml:a7af79af76b2:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_small.xml:77b2b5ef91f2:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_medium.xml:45c0ef710323:L2-L2, resource:rom/data/definitions/motor_large.xml:9e4e7a53ba4b:L2-L2.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/11/findings/20/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Torque, speed, fuel use and efficiency curves are unknown. Internal configuration fields are not measured force, torque, watts or joules.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/106/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> The throttle input range is unspecified.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/106/limitations/5`

**Definition-only extraction**

> motor_small: attributes.electric_magnitude. Component-specific charge multiplier. Recovered motor, generator and starter equations are covered by the practical behaviour research; physical units remain unresolved.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/106/findings/8/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> motor_medium: attributes.electric_magnitude. Component-specific charge multiplier. Recovered motor, generator and starter equations are covered by the practical behaviour research; physical units remain unresolved.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/106/findings/21/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> motor_large: attributes.electric_magnitude. Component-specific charge multiplier. Recovered motor, generator and starter equations are covered by the practical behaviour research; physical units remain unresolved.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/106/findings/34/detail`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.

comments.body: Partly answered in 15d8691: speed is RPS, shaft groups weight by force_emitter_max_force, the draw factor is max(0, 1 - emp/300) x pool charge fraction (see investigation/electricity.md). Still open: SI/voltage conversion and the remaining items listed on the wiki page.

title: Electric Motor: decode remaining behavior and formulas
